transport: UTF-8 JSONL stdin/stdout; native diagnostic stderr; token events contain raw token IDs

generate.prompt: Official Jinja rendered text with enable_thinking=false

cancel: SIGUSR1 to this owned process; abort callback plus generation-loop checks; wait for CANCELLED result; discard partial output
reset: llama_memory_clear(llama_get_memory(ctx), true); both KV and recurrent/conv buffers; also done before every generation
diagnostics: Optional --profile-nodes at process startup fences every graph node, inhibits fusion and adds overhead; never normal throughput. save_logits_reference / compare_logits retain one vocabulary vector only on explicit request.
sessions: Client retains messages, renders official template and replays full history. Single in-flight request, not a production service API.
sampling: Greedy; all generated tokens recorded, no reasoning-output filtering
reference: F16 GGUF derived from original BF16; not an independent Transformers forward implementation
quantized: Q4_K_M baseline, NOT custom W4A8 sidecar/S1
limits: PC Linux only verified; graceful shutdown may finish current request, use SIGUSR1 for cancellation; not medical quality acceptance
